name: Computacenter plc
summary: Computacenter plc provides technology and services to corporate and public sector organizations in the United Kingdom, Germany, Western Europe, North America, and internationally. It offers procurement, specialist, software, logistical, technical, and circular technology sourcing services; IT strategy and advisory, integration, deployment, and support services; and managed services.
